messages.subject: Re: Bioc-teaching call June 14, 2-3pm CEST
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

on Monday (June 14) we’ll have our next bioc-teaching call (2pm CEST). We’ll continue working on the lessons that are under development, and plan for the BioC2021 workshop. If you have additional topics that you would like to cover, please feel free to add them to the agenda google doc!

Jitsi link:  https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

See you on Monday,
Charlotte & Laurent
